title: Invoice a quote
summary: Generate the invoice for what's pending on a confirmed quote.

steps.title: Menu → Sales → Quotes
steps.details: The treatment plan with prices for the patient to approve; once confirmed it's invoiced, booked and charged.

steps.title: Open the quote
steps.details: Tap the quote in the list. The guide continues once its details open.

steps.title: Pending invoicing
steps.details: The Invoice button only shows if the quote is confirmed and has something left to invoice.

steps.title: Invoice
steps.details: Invoices what's pending on the quote: you choose which services and how much, and a draft invoice is created.

steps.title: What to invoice
steps.details: Choose the pending services and amounts, the due date and notes. What's already invoiced isn't repeated.

steps.title: Create invoice
steps.details: It stays as a draft in Invoices; confirm it to be able to charge it.
